🎥🎬: Real Steel (2011)

In a future where human boxing has been replaced by massive fighting robots, former boxer Charlie Kenton makes a living moving from one robotic fight to another. Struggling with debt and a broken-down machine, Charlie unexpectedly reconnects with his young son, Max, after years apart.

While searching for parts, Max discovers an old sparring robot named Atom buried beneath a junkyard. Unlike the advanced machines dominating the sport, Atom is outdated and controlled manually—but he has an incredible ability to learn and take a punch.

As Charlie and Max train Atom for bigger fights, the father and son slowly rebuild their relationship. Their journey takes them from underground matches to the biggest stage in robot boxing, where Atom must face the seemingly unstoppable champion Zeus.
